properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 2 at 11:02AM EDT until September 2 at 11:45AM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
SVRCTP

The National Weather Service in State College PA has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Bedford County in south central Pennsylvania...
Southern Blair County in central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Cambria County in central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Cumberland County in south central Pennsylvania...
Central Franklin County in south central Pennsylvania...
Northeastern Fulton County in south central Pennsylvania...
Southern Huntingdon County in central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Juniata County in central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Mifflin County in central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Perry County in south central Pennsylvania...
Northeastern Somerset County in south central Pennsylvania...

* Until 1145 AM EDT.

* At 1101 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Blacklog to Trough Creek State Park to Roaring
Spring to Vinco, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Severe thunderstorms will be near...
Portage, Shy Beaver, and Rockhill Furnace around 1110 AM EDT.
New Enterprise, Coaldale, and Doylesburg around 1120 AM EDT.
Osterburg, Waterfall, and Willow Hill around 1130 AM EDT.

Other locations impacted by these severe thunderstorms include
Orrstown, Saltillo, Mundys Corner, Spring Hill, and Cassandra.

Radar has indicated rotation within these severe thunderstorms.
Although a tornado is not immediately likely, tornadoes can develop
quickly during severe thunderstorms.

This includes the following Interstates...
Interstate 70 from mile markers 147 to 148.
The Pennsylvania Turnpike from mile markers 142 to 208.
Interstate 81 from mile markers 21 to 34.
Interstate 99 from mile markers 0 to 26.
properties.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Very heavy rainfall is occurring with these severe thunderstorms, and
may lead to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 2 at 5:46AM CDT until September 2 at 10:45AM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
FFWLCH

The National Weather Service in Lake Charles has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Hardin County in southeastern Texas...
South Central Tyler County in southeastern Texas...

* Until 1045 AM CDT.

* At 546 AM CDT, emergency management reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 10 and 21
inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 5
inches in 1 hour. Flash flooding is already occurring.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Kountze, Village Mills, Honey Island.
This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lumberton, Kountze, Wildwood, Saratoga, Warren, Honey Island,
Village Mills and Batson.

Down stream locations such as Village Creek State Park and low areas
between Silsbee and Lumberton.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 2 at 10:35AM CDT until September 3 at 4:00PM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Houston/Galveston has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Long King Creek near Livingston affecting Polk and San Jacinto
Counties.

For the Long King Creek...including Livingston...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Long King Creek near Livingston.

* WHEN...From this morning to Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 19.0 feet, At levels above 19 feet, minor lowland
flooding begins as water escapes the main channel of the creek. At
25.0 feet, At levels above 25 feet, moderate lowland flooding
begins as low-lying areas along the creek become inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 19.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 14.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 AM CDT Wednesday was 19.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 23.1 feet
this evening. It will then fall below flood stage late tonight.
- Flood stage is 19.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 23.2
feet on 07/27/2024.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/hgx.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 445 AM CDT.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 2 at 7:53AM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Lake Charles has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Jasper,
Hardin, Jefferson and Orange Counties.

Village Creek Near Kountze affecting Hardin County.

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

For the Neches River...including Town Bluff, Evadale, Neches River
Saltwater Barrier...Moderate flooding is forecast.
For the Village Creek...including Kountze...Major flooding is
forecast.
For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 800 PM CDT.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier.

* WHEN...From this morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 7.0 feet, Water begins to go over Bigner Road into the
saltwater barrier. Water also cuts off most access to the Four Oaks
Ranch Road downstream of Four Oaks boat launch. Flooding of
Colliers Ferry Park and secondary roads near the river can be
expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:15 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 3.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this morning and continue rising to a crest of 7.1 feet Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 4.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 7.6
feet on 05/31/2015.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
